capability: Account-level API: the platform's API over the merchant's account rather than one store, reaching all the account's stores and its control panel users, with credentials and scopes of its own (BigCommerce GraphQL Account API, Account API, account-level API credentials, account_* scopes)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Account API [graphql], BC-I-0109) beside the store-level Admin API. Parent CM-API-001 because BigCommerce lists it among its API accounts (BC-S-0302: store-level, app-level and account-level credentials).

capability: Staging environments: environments where a store's updates are tested and previewed, then deployed, without disrupting the live storefront (BigCommerce Staging environments, StagingPro)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: a product line of its own (BC-I-0540). Not a development store (CM-DVT-004): it stages a live store's changes, not a free store for building apps and themes. No parent: no statement groups it under the developer tools.

capability: Commerce-as-a-Service for partners: partner APIs through which a partner offers the platform's stores to its own merchants, creates and onboards them, changes their plans, and may own their billing (BigCommerce Powered By, Beta Powered By, Commerce-as-a-Service)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Beta Powered By, BC-I-0115) and a product line. Not partner stores (CM-DVT-003): the stores are the partner's merchants' live stores, which the partner resells.
